task.title: P6-100: Enable DFC flip on catalog tiles and other card render paths
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-100. Size: S-M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**DFC flip is unavailable on the catalog tiles and everywhere else the card renders outside the hover/sheet/detail paths.** `CardTile` mounts `CardPreview` with `hover = false` (`catalog.rs:720`), so `FlipButton` is reachable only via the touch sheet or the detail page — never on the tile itself.
